title: unified-rollouts: probing staged shadow autorollback enhancements
author: Priya Khatri
body: Motivation: improve safety and observability for staged shadow and probing-based rollouts while enabling automated metric-driven rollback across canary and A/B workflows. This change implements a probing scheduler that limits probe traffic to configurable windows, a composite-metric evaluator that supports tolerance bands and roll-forward/back decisions, and additional tracing/metrics to diagnose probing instability. Design highlights: 1) probing scheduler: coordinates staged shadow probes with backoff and jitter to avoid thundering herd on upstream models and downstream services; 2) composite evaluator: evaluates multiple metrics (latency p99, error-rate, perplexity/regression score) against configurable thresholds and rolling baselines; supports metric matching and transparent weight decay when metrics are noisy; 3) autorollback controller: ties evaluator output to rollout controller to trigger immediate rollback, progressive rampdown, or shadow-only fallback based on policy; 4) observability: new rollout tracer spans, rollout-level histograms, metric drift alerts and enhanced logs for probe sessions; 5) safety: added stability guards and e2e tests to reduce false positives. Implementation notes: changes are limited to the rollout controller and strategy packages, adds a new probing strategy module, updates the CRD with new policy fields, and extends the observability package with rollout-scoped metric names. Testing: unit tests for scheduler and evaluator, integration tests simulating noisy metrics and downstream failures, and e2e canary scenarios in the CI cluster. Rollout plan: merged to main behind feature flag rollout.probing_v2; staged rollout to canary orgs for two weeks before enabling by default. Follow-ups: documentation updates for the rollout policy schema and a runbook entry for interpreting composite evaluator decisions. See linked Linear items for product acceptance criteria.

release_notes: Improves rollout safety for staged shadow and probing strategies by adding a probing scheduler, composite metric evaluator, automated rollback workflows and additional observability. Feature gated behind rollout.probing_v2; disabled by default. See docs/runbooks/rollouts.md for guidance.
notes: Feature is behind a feature flag and will be enabled progressively. Ops runbook added and linked to SUP-4421 for initial canary monitoring.
